title: Mango Meteor
tagline: Slice the fruit, dodge the meteor, keep the juice contained.
description: Mangoes fall from an optimistic sky while a meteor crosses the kitchen window. Slice the fruit in matching arcs and collect juice multipliers.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Mango Meteor. Mangoes fall from an optimistic sky while a meteor crosses the kitchen window. Slice the fruit in matching arcs and collect juice multipliers.
